#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
#
# The destination is not fixed in this repo (it depends on which host this
# runs on / what backup storage is available there), so it is read from the
# BACKUP_DEST environment variable at run time:
#   - BACKUP_DEST=/some/local/or/mounted/path   -> copied with cp
#   - BACKUP_DEST=user@host:/remote/path        -> copied with scp
#
# Whoever wires this into cron (see register-job.sh) must export BACKUP_DEST
# in the job's environment before tonight's run, otherwise the script fails
# loudly instead of silently skipping the copy.
set -eu

DEST="${BACKUP_DEST:-}"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "backup.sh: BACKUP_DEST is not set; refusing to run without a destination" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        # host:path form -> remote copy
        scp -q "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
    *)
        # local path or mount
        mkdir -p "$DEST"
        cp -p "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"

arguments.command:
chmod +x backup.sh; sh -n backup.sh && echo "syntax OK"
echo "--- test: no DEST set ---"
(unset BACKUP_DEST; ./backup.sh; echo "exit: $?") || true
echo "--- test: local DEST ---"
mkdir -p /tmp/backup_dest
BACKUP_DEST=/tmp/backup_dest ./backup.sh
ls -la /tmp/backup_dest
rm -f logs-*.tar.gz
rm -rf /tmp/backup_dest
